title: METHOD FOR RAPID AND SENSITIVE DETECTION OF IGM RETROVIRAL ANTIBODIES
abstract: PCT No. PCT/US88/02257 Sec. 371 Date May 5, 1989 Sec. 102(e) Date May 5, 1989 PCT Filed Jul. 5, 1988 PCT Pub. No. WO89/00609 PCT Pub. Date Jan. 26, 1989.A rapid and sensitive assay method for the detection of IgM antibody or the simultaneous detection of IgG and IgM antibody to retroviruses, including HIV-1 and HIV-2, and diagnostic test kits for carrying out the method is provided. According to the method of the invention, results are obtainable within 70 minutes.
